Subject: Rate card request: rerank/classifier scoring model

Hi Ben / Marissa,

We're evaluating Redwood's hosted API for a reranking workflow. A few practical questions for procurement so we can build an accurate TCO:

1) For "rerank" and "classifier" endpoints, how is billing applied when we score N candidates per query? Is it per API call, per-candidate scored, or driven by token counts?
2) Do you treat batch scoring (e.g., 100 queries x 50 candidates) differently for discounts or unit pricing?
3) Are embeddings or other auxiliary calls (for feature prep) billed separately?
4) Baseline per-unit pricing and volume breakpoints (monthly) — we expect 10M scoring events/month with ~50 candidates per event.

Could you send a short rate card or example estimate with the above shape? If helpful I can share a redacted sample workload.

Thanks,

DataSift

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Rate card request: rerank/classifier scoring model

Hi Claire — great questions, thanks for the detail. Short answers up front, then a simple worked example and attached draft rate card.

Summary:
- Rerank/classifier billing is primarily per-scored candidate ("per-eval") for deterministic scoring workloads. We also bill token usage for any requests that perform generation (e.g., candidate expansion or soft prompts that produce text).
- Batch requests are supported. Volume discounts apply to total scored-candidates/month, not per-batch call.
- Embeddings called separately (e.g., for feature lookup) are billed under the embeddings rate card.

Baseline pricing (hosted API, standard plan):
- Classifier / Rerank evaluation: $0.0006 per candidate scored (per-eval).
- Per-request flat fee: $0.001 per API call (covers routing, KV cache lookups).
- Tokens (input/output) for generation-related work: charged at $0.0004 per 1K tokens (when applicable).

Worked example (your 10M events/month x 50 candidates):
- Scored candidates = 10,000,000 * 50 = 500,000,000 evaluations
- Per-eval cost = 500,000,000 * $0.0006 = $300,000
- Per-call flat fees = 10,000,000 * $0.001 = $10,000
- Total baseline = ~$310,000/month (embeddings or generation work would be added on top)

Volume discounts:
- 10–50M scored candidates/month: 10% off per-eval rate
- 50–200M: 20% off
- 200M+: tiered pricing and potential Dedicated commitment required

I've attached a one-page rate card and a quick spreadsheet estimate. If you want, we can model your exact candidate distribution and provide a discounted quote for a committed 12-month volume.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: 2026-02-12_Rerank_RateCard_v1.pdf

Subject: Re: Rate card request: rerank/classifier scoring model

Thanks Ben — that's helpful. A few follow-ups:

- For the "per-eval" model, how do you handle multi-stage scoring where we first filter with a cheap model (local) and then call Redwood to score the top K candidates? Is the per-eval only charged for the calls you process (i.e., K), correct?
- For rerank, if we submit a single API call with 50 candidates vs 50 separate calls, does the per-call flat fee apply once (single call) or 50x?
- Do you offer a blended rate if we commit to a minimum (e.g., 12 months, 10M scored-candidates/month)?

Example clarification: our expected pattern is client-side filter -> call to Redwood with top-K (K~=50) per query. We will also run periodic batch scoring jobs where we score 10M historical query-candidate pairs overnight (these would be batched single calls).

Also, embeddings are a separate pipeline for us — good to confirm they are billed separately.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so procurement can build the PO.

Claire
